name: Pull-up
steps: Hang from bar, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, palms away.
Engage core and pull until chin clears the bar.
Lower with control over 3 seconds, full extension.
footer: Beginner — 3×5 reps — 2 min rest, controlled 3s descent

name: Chin-up
steps: Hang with palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull chest toward bar, squeezing biceps at the top.
Lower slowly for full range of motion.

name: Lat Pulldown
steps: Sit with thighs under pads. Grip bar wider than shoulder-width.
Pull bar to upper chest, elbows pointing straight down.
Return slowly with full control.

name: Barbell Row
steps: Hinge at hips, back flat, grip slightly wider than shoulders.
Row bar to lower chest, drive elbows back.
Lower the bar with control.

name: Dumbbell Row
steps: Plant knee and hand on bench. Back flat, dumbbell hanging.
Row dumbbell to hip, keep elbow close to body.
Lower fully to feel the stretch.

name: Cable Row
steps: Sit upright, feet on platform, slight forward lean.
Pull handle to abdomen, squeeze shoulder blades together.
Slowly return, keep back stable throughout.

name: Face Pull
steps: Set cable at face height. Grip rope with both hands.
Pull toward face, elbows flared out at shoulder height.
Control the return, do not let weight crash.

name: Hammer Curl
steps: Stand with dumbbells at sides, palms facing inward (neutral grip).
Curl up keeping neutral grip throughout the movement.
Lower slowly, feel full stretch at bottom.

name: Concentration Curl
steps: Sit, rest elbow on inner thigh. Dumbbell hanging.
Curl fully, squeeze hard at the top.
Lower slowly for maximum tension.

name: Bench Press
steps: Lie flat, grip slightly wider than shoulders, bar over chest.
Lower bar to chest, elbows at 45° angle.
Press explosively back to start.

name: Overhead Press
steps: Stand, bar at upper chest, grip shoulder-width.
Press straight overhead, lock out at top.
Lower controlled back to start position.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
steps: Set bench to 30–45°. Dumbbells at chest level.
Press up and slightly inward to touch at top.
Lower slowly, feel chest stretch.

name: Lateral Raise
steps: Stand with dumbbells at sides, slight bend in elbow.
Raise arms to shoulder height, lead with elbows.
Lower slowly — no swinging.

name: Tricep Dip
steps: Grip parallel bars, arms straight, body upright.
Dip until upper arms are parallel to floor.
Press back up powerfully.

name: Push-up
steps: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in straight line.
Lower chest to floor, elbows at 45°.
Push up powerfully, maintain straight body.

name: Cable Fly
steps: Set cables high, step forward with slight forward lean.
Sweep arms together in front of chest in arc.
Open wide slowly with full control.

name: Squat
steps: Bar on upper traps, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Squat down keeping chest tall, knees track over toes.
Drive through heels to return to standing.

name: Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand tall, bar in hands in front of thighs.
Hinge at hips, push them back, back stays flat.
Drive hips forward to return — do not round back.

name: Leg Press
steps: Sit in machine, feet shoulder-width on platform.
Lower platform until 90° knee bend.
Press back without fully locking knees.

name: Plank
steps: Forearms flat, body in straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze core, glutes, and quads simultaneously.
Breathe steadily, hold without sagging.

name: Crunch
steps: Lie on back, knees bent, hands lightly behind head.
Curl shoulders off floor, squeeze abs at top.
Lower slowly — do not use momentum.

name: Leg Raise
steps: Lie flat, legs straight and together.
Raise legs to 90°, press lower back into floor.
Lower slowly without touching floor.

name: Treadmill Run
steps: Warm up at easy pace for 3 min, arms relaxed.
Run at moderate intensity (6–8 km/h), maintain posture.
Cool down last 3 min, gradually lower speed.

name: Jump Rope
steps: Stand with rope behind feet, handles at hip height.
Swing rope overhead and jump lightly over it.
Keep jumps low and maintain a consistent rhythm.

name: Stationary Bike
steps: Adjust seat: leg slightly bent at bottom of pedal stroke.
Pedal at moderate resistance, smooth cadence.
Aim for 70–90 RPM, keep upper body relaxed.

name: Burpees
steps: Stand, squat down and place hands on floor.
Jump feet back into plank, do one push-up.
Explode up with arms overhead.
